name: Vacuum Shard (Nozzle Fragment)
description: A glowing shard from the shattered Vacuum of Eternity, pulsing with cosmic cleaning power

interactions.examine: This shard appears to be part of the Vacuum of Eternity's nozzle. It glows with an inner light and hums quietly with barely-contained power. The edges are sharp but somehow don't cut you. Looking at it fills you with equal parts hope and guilt.
interactions.take: You pick up the vacuum shard carefully. It feels warm and vibrates gently in your hand, as if eager to be whole again.
